assets.prompt_record: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one opaque environment-painting atlas for a hand-painted underwater mermaid game. Paint FOUR different narrow VERTICAL underwater descent passages, side by side in FOUR exactly equal columns across a 2048 by 768 landscape canvas. Each column is its own coherent 512-by-768 view looking straight into a natural flooded limestone cleft; there are no dividing lines or labels. The top of each passage opens into luminous shallow turquoise water, with soft daylight filtering down. The bottom leads deeper into a peaceful blue grotto. Clear softly textured water occupies the middle third of every passage, with irregular cream-and-teal limestone shoulders, wispy seagrass, occasional small white shell fossils and natural hanging kelp at the left and right edges. Beautiful hand-painted children's adventure storybook quality, restrained brushwork, atmospheric perspective, subtle caustic light, soft irregular rock forms. Columns 1 and 2 use a pearl-and-seafoam nursery palette and visibly different cliff silhouettes. Columns 3 and 4 use a slightly lavender-blue bellflower grotto palette, a few tiny hanging bell-like sea flowers at the edges, and different asymmetric clefts. Maintain continuous vertical water flow and generous swimmable negative space; the passage should feel naturally carved and inviting rather than a geometric doorway. No sky or above-water horizon, no floor cutting across the middle, no straight-sided rectangles within any column, no repeated arch motif, no buildings, no characters, no treasure, no text, no UI, no outlines, no grid. This is production game scenery rather than a contact-sheet photograph, and the painterly colour should fill the entire canvas.
